scope: Phase 01 static source audit and reconciliation decisions, not implementation

shared.reason: Keep student secret/enable placeholders; J5 open-email comments are not authorization. Add separate disabled J12345/J5 placeholders only; no values.
Preserve rotated credential revalidation and unresolved genuine event/browser acceptance; append J5 gates separately.

Dependencies and devDependencies identical; no upgrade. Preserve J1234 prebuild/typecheck and add J5 all/PDF/level/course/private-build checks. Explicitly include j1234 tests in final verification; verify script alone omits glob. Private build runner must not bypass prebuild tests.
Keep J1234 identity/operator/directory/billing/attendance checks. Extend exact new branch; add J5 provider, curriculum, PDF, progress, assessment and live acceptance gates, no secrets or false pass.

Keep notice version and consent timestamp checks, canonical child ID, UUID request validation, registration intent deduplication, CAS and sibling ownership. Do not restore older request-key-only creation.
Keep global quota plus cross-purpose recipient CAS cooldown and hourly limit. J5 version lacks integrated recipient guard.
Keep separate parent/test and student proof v2 roles, namespaces, five-minute proof TTL, twelve-hour parent TTL, confirmed session and CAS revocation. No parent-only rollback.
Same blob; preserve. Exact integration authorization remains in callers.
Keep export to shared j2-runtime; older J5 inline handler would omit integrated proof/identity logic. No duplicate OTP service.
Keep response validation, retry/error handling, approved inbox and duplicate-review messages. Only add compatible error text if necessary.
Keep existing type fix; legacy Wix browser OAuth is not J2 student authentication.
Keep signal:signal??null strict type fix; J5 conditional spread equivalent when absent. Private routes must use J2-authorized server APIs, not legacy member token.
Keep student selection, individual PIN enrollment, integrated checkout, resend timer, request fingerprint and logout. Reject old parent dashboard redirect/walkthrough restoration.
Keep J1234 exact optional diagram type fix; neither variant proves grading authority. Private execution requires server question/grade/attempt APIs, no answer keys in public bundle.

Keep J1234 auth, checkout, worker, staff and attendance mounts/denials; introduce J5 overview/course/PDF dispatch with exact branch and explicit gates. Wire same authoritative provider or refuse, wrap SSR course path, preserve fallback and production behavior.
Keep J1/J12/J123/J1234 assertions, add J12345 disabled/unknown branch/production/secret-redaction/gate tests. J5 old branch-only heading assertions cannot replace them.
Same blob; preserve and rerun in full suite.
Existing integration foundation disables new branch. Union standalone J2/J5 disabled entries later; keep main disabled and no automatic/manual deployment.
Keep TanStack Start/Nitro setup and exact preview flags, add private-build mode/plugin/env safeguards without dev-server leakage. Do not enable standalone J4 fixture on combined branch.
